title: Easy Digital Downloads Launch
description: Pre-launch checklist for EDD stores — payments, downloads, taxes, emails, and test purchases.

steps.title: Configure Store & Currency
steps.instructions: Set business name, currency, and base country under Downloads → Settings → General. Confirm decimal and thousand separators.

steps.title: Enable Payment Gateways
steps.instructions: Configure Stripe, PayPal, or other gateways in live mode. Complete account verification and test webhook endpoints.

steps.title: Verify Download Files & Limits
steps.instructions: Upload files to secure storage. Set download limits, expiry, and file access rules per product. Test file delivery links.

steps.title: Configure Tax Settings
steps.instructions: Enable taxes if required for the client's jurisdiction. Set inclusive/exclusive pricing and validate rates on checkout.

steps.title: Customize Purchase Emails
steps.instructions: Brand receipt and download emails. Send test purchase, renewal, and failed payment notifications to agency inboxes.

steps.title: Assign Checkout & Success Pages
steps.instructions: Confirm checkout, confirmation, failure, and account pages are assigned and styled. Guest checkout policy matches client requirements.

steps.title: Complete Test Purchases
steps.instructions: Buy each product type with live and test modes as appropriate. Verify order records, download links, and admin notifications.
